source_name: EverQuestie approved Shattering of Ro travel evidence

edges.evidence: Fanra's Shattering of Ro travel section states that Arcstone, Shattered Isles may be entered from West Freeport and requires completion of Partisan of Candlemaker's Workshop. The source zone is pinned to current Live West Freeport client zone 383 so the reviewed transition cannot bind the retired same-name Freeport identity.

travel_requirements.text: Requires completion of Partisan of Candlemaker's Workshop

edges.evidence: EverQuest's January 21, 2026 update notes refer to the Ruined Relic zone-in from Arcstone, Shattered Isles, corroborating this directed transition.
A current Shattering of Ro travel discussion explicitly identifies a zoneline from Relic to Vortex.
A current Shattering of Ro travel discussion explicitly identifies a zoneline from Vortex to Labyrinth of Spite.
